metadata.title: Yang-Mills-Higgs Limits of Reflexive Higgs Sheaves
metadata.abstract: For stable Higgs bundles, Hermitian-Einstein metrics can be obtained as limits of the Yang-Mills-Higgs (Y-M-H) flow. We study the algebraic structure of subsequential limits of this flow for reflexive Higgs sheaves over compact Kähler manifolds, without assuming stability. We prove that the limiting reflexive Higgs sheaf is isomorphic to the double dual of the graded sheaf associated with the Harder-Narasimhan-Seshadri filtration of the initial sheaf.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: Yang–Mills–Higgs 流极限的代数识别
analysis.workSummary: 在紧 Kähler 流形上，对不必稳定的反射 Higgs 层，作者研究 Yang–Mills–Higgs 流的子列极限，证明极限反射 Higgs 层同构于初始层 Harder–Narasimhan–Seshadri 滤过之分次层的双对偶。
analysis.breakthrough: 把不稳定且可能有奇点的初始对象的分析极限，与其规范代数分解明确对应，推广稳定 Higgs 丛由流得到 Hermitian–Einstein 度量的背景图景。
analysis.limitations: 结论识别的是子列极限的反射 Higgs 层，不等于原流在全流形上光滑收敛，也未在摘要中给出整个流的无子列收敛或全部能量集中的描述。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
